title: Sentry

signIn.hint: Sign in in the capture browser first; an organization's pages are on <org>.sentry.io.

rules.note: An issue page's "Set up Session Replay" ad and Seer pitch (with the Jump to: Replay link), when they aren't the demo's topic: hidden, and the sections around them close up. A demo about Replay or Seer turns it off (packs.offRules: ["sentry:no-replay-ad"]).

fallbacks: Sentry's theme tokens come from prefers-color-scheme: both themes are in every page, so the scheme flip covers it without a pack (not scored yet)

notes: Recorded once (LTG1189: the issues list and two issue pages). Busy markers, things to ignore and hover delays aren't known yet: the recorder's defaults apply.
sources: ltg1189-replica capture/css-hook.mjs (Sentry's theme tokens follow prefers-color-scheme)
